headline: Vietnam's Resort Real Estate Faces Series of Bottlenecks; Experts Propose Solutions
summary: Vietnam's resort tourism real estate faces bottlenecks in legal matters, planning, capital flows and market confidence. Experts have proposed solutions to unblock the market.
why: Resort property development depends on land-use rules and financing, so bottlenecks in these areas can delay projects and affect investors in the sector.
